candidates.adaptation_notes: Uses SpaRC RAR/SFF as a query-feature residual, not as a new query generator and not as BEV distillation. Targets rain because radar should retain signal when camera semantics degrade.
candidates.kill_condition: BLOCK if aux_weight=0 is not bit-identical within max diff 1e-6, if less than 35% of rain GT objects have at least one radar point in the adaptive neighborhood, if mini rain mAP proxy fails to improve by at least 0.005, or if clean mini mAP drops by more than 0.010.
candidates.mechanism_paragraph: SpaRC argues that sparse radar-camera fusion can avoid dense BEV-grid rendering by aligning image semantics with radar/camera point features, then using range-adaptive radar aggregation and local self-attention around object-centric queries. Adapt this to RaCFormer as a lightweight radar-neighborhood adapter that pools radar BEV tokens around each existing polar query with a range-dependent radius and gates the decoder feature; the polar query coordinates are retained and only receive an additive residual.

candidates.adaptation_notes: Rejects RayFormer query re-initialization; accepts only ray-aware feature sampling for existing RaCFormer polar queries, avoiding Branch D hard query replacement.
candidates.kill_condition: BLOCK if offset scale 0 is not identity within max diff 1e-6, if far-query pixel-collision rate is not reduced by at least 20% on the diagnostic split, if far mAP proxy fails to improve by at least 0.005, or if clean mini mAP drops by more than 0.010.
candidates.mechanism_paragraph: RayFormer identifies a failure mode where nearby 3D queries on the same camera ray sample nearly identical image pixels, producing ambiguous query features, and proposes ray-centric initialization and sampling strategies. Adapt only the sampling side: keep RaCFormer polar queries fixed, but add a ray-spread sampler that offsets image sampling points along the local epipolar/range direction for far-range queries so adjacent polar queries receive less duplicated image evidence.
